correctness.rationale: Modal trace strictly negative and determinant exactly (ell-5/2)(ell-7/2). Invariant subspaces yield entire n-vertex spectrum and all statuses. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: These general instability tests decide a specified graph if its spectrum is known but do not themselves construct arbitrarily long alternating chains using only additive unweighted edges. We do not assert that a general instability criterion is new. The possible further coverage in unread material is a residual risk.

evidence: Standard spectral theory yields stability iff no Laplacian eigenvalue lies in the Turing band; this precursor is acknowledged.

The stronger new conclusion requires the explicit family of nested connected unit-weight graphs with exactly one 3-eigenmode at odd stages and none at even stages, and an extremal Θ(n) reversal-count comparison.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The classical modal criterion and Weyl monotonicity alone do not assert the existence of this many one-edge alternating topology snapshots. The proof supplies a specific scalable gadget and a global order bound, while leaving existing general results untouched.

evidence: Van Gorder 2021 treats both static-network Turing criteria and temporally changing weighted networks; periodic repeats can recur by reversing edges, which is not monotone addition.
The proposed construction never removes or changes any edge, and starts and ends strict stable at 2k successive steps.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Changing labels from temporal transition to frozen graph stability cannot supply the claim: repeated periodic changes alter edge weights backward, whereas monotone unit-edge addition restricts all Laplacian eigenvalues to nondecrease. The all-size edge gadget and count are additional statements.

evidence: No examined finite graph table or identified research entry supplied the hub-of-triples spectrum sequence (1,1) to (1,3) to (2,4) or the Θ(n) reversal law.
The new checker verifies exact polynomial spectra in 72 finite cases and is not used to infer uniqueness among prior publications.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: This is an all-size construction and asymptotic bound, not a small graph numerical table. No table-found evidence dominates it; negative retrieval is not alone evidence of originality.

originality.rationale: The new claim is an all-size, fixed-kinetics, monotone-unit-edge-insertion construction of linearly many strict whole-system reversals with a matching-order eigenvalue-monotonicity upper bound. Examined broad network-Turing work does not state this construction or count. One closely related complete paper remains unread, so priority risk is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: The complete Mimar et al. 2019 preprint/journal text could not be inspected; the accessible parts may omit a directly overlapping theorem.
Other network-spectral constructions or a broad graph gadget theorem might imply the result without matching its ecological wording.
Claims concern frozen-topology local linear stability only, not temporal transitions or nonlinear patterned attractors.

value.rationale: A structural linearly growing number of reversals under edge additions only, with a universal linear upper bound, provides a mathematically motivated benchmark for whether added dispersal connectivity monotonically stabilizes a homogeneous ecological equilibrium. The exact motif, open parameter region and fixed equal link weights make the phenomenon non-arbitrary; no empirical application is claimed.
